decisions: Separate FinishAfter eligibility, EscrowFinish, destination receipt, transfers, re-escrow and market disposition.
Any account may submit EscrowFinish after validated-ledger close passes FinishAfter; do not attribute sender to Ripple without hash.
Destination is predetermined; identify it before classifying transfers.
70% prior re-escrow is historical baseline only.
Keep TradRadar venue series separate; account ratio is not notional and liquidations are lower bound.
Null sentiment means missing/stale data, not neutral; full-history entity scores are not current.
Knowledge Signal Cycle is manual-only; do not schedule direct main writes.
Main writers remain active; PRs stale/open/unmerged; required status checks empty.
No directional feature admitted; no forecast.
required_verification: After 00:00Z query both escrow objects at a pinned validated ledger; record EscrowFinish hashes, senders, amounts, ledger indexes and Destination accounts.
Capture destination balances before/after; trace transfers and EscrowCreate re-escrow.
Identify exchange/OTC movements before inferring sell pressure.
Capture synchronized XRP spot, venue OI/funding/basis/liquidations/depth and BTC/ETH controls.
Restore fresh ingestion through read-only/isolated branch or artifact; enforce freshness and minimum-sample gates.
Reconcile stale PRs individually; no merge or bulk rebase.
